## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: low market breadth plus narrow leadership (Top 5: ORCL, INTC, AMD, QCOM, EL — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology)), and a major divergence between broad sector weakness and strong mega-cap/semiconductor performance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: ORCL (1W: +20.57% | 1M: +35.92%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples and Consumer Discretionary follow: EL (1W: +11.18% | 1M: +19.39%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +19.97%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy weakest: OXY (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -9.75%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND. Utilities and Healthcare also weak: XOM (1W: -5.02% | 1M: -6.17%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.19% | 1M: -7.79%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +20.57% | 1M: +35.92%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +16.02% | 1M: +85.95%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.22% | 1M: +76.20%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +12.79% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +11.18% | 1M: +19.39%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: OXY (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -9.75%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, BMY (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and select Industrials/Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +20.57%), INTC (1W: +16.02%), AMD (1W: +15.22%), QCOM (1W: +12.79%), LRCX (1W: +11.11%) — all ABOVE TREND. Watch divergence: large-cap tech/semis momentum vs. weak overall breadth is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE — tactical, not full regime confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology shows concentrated strength led by semiconductors and select software: AAPL (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +11.02%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +12.41%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND; sector returns positive but leadership narrow — monitor for dispersion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are mixed-to-weak: JPM (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -0.55%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.60% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W negative and failing to confirm rotation into value.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare shows defensive cracks with headline names weaker: JNJ (1W: -3.19% | 1M: -7.79%) BELOW TREND, BMY (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, while LLY (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +2.27%) ABOVE TREND is an exception; sector breadth is soft.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Growth/Momentum exposure in top semiconductors and software (ORCL, NVDA, AMD) while reducing exposure to Energy and lagging cyclicals (OXY, COP, EOG); style: Growth/Momentum tilt but market cautionary given narrow leadership and weak breadth.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +12.79% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND — bullish sentiment (+65) confirmed by price. BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +20.57% | 1M: +35.92%) ABOVE TREND — momentum continues. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION — negative sentiment (-50) confirming price weakness.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +17.67%) — concentrated leadership in semis/software. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -2.94%) — broad weakness, multiple names BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND for consolidation above recent highs as momentum trigger; monitor AAPL (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +11.02%) ABOVE TREND for continuation; watch OXY (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -9.75%) BELOW TREND for downside follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
QCOM (+65): Qualcomm partnership and buyback headline; price QCOM (1W: +12.79% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. TXN (+80) headline bullish (beat & raise) — monitor TXN price action for confirmation (sector-level support in semis).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (-50): Downgrade commentary; price PYPL (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirming the 1W weakness. MA (-45): PT cut headline; price MA (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND — watch for further follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Growth/Momentum tilt. ORCL, NVDA, AAPL are showing relative strength (ALL ABOVE TREND). Key risk: narrow tech leadership amid weak breadth and sentiment-driven divergences (monitor PYPL and Energy names for downside).
